hero.headline: The internet, open again
hero.subtitle: Sites and apps open the way they used to. One subscription for your devices, and paid plans do not cap traffic.
hero.note: Setup takes a couple of minutes. No card is required to open the dashboard.

features.title: Everything a VPN needs — nothing it does not

protocols.title: Modern protocols
protocols.text: VLESS Reality and XTLS: your traffic looks like ordinary HTTPS, so the connection holds where a classic VPN already fails.

speed.title: No speed ceiling
speed.text: Servers on wide uplinks: 4K video, calls and large downloads run without stalls or queues.

locations.title: Locations to choose from
locations.text: Several countries in one subscription. Switch between servers right in the app, in a single tap.

noLogs.title: No logs, no tracking
noLogs.text: We keep no connection history and share nothing with third parties. Websites see the server address, not yours.

devices.title: Every device
devices.text: iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux and Smart TV. One subscription covers several devices at once.

support.title: Support in Telegram
support.text: Real people answer: they help with setup, payments and anything that goes wrong.

path.title: Your provider sees an ordinary connection
path.text: What gets blocked is a recognizable trace in the traffic, not the word VPN. The connection looks like ordinary encrypted traffic, so the provider has nothing to latch onto.

device.title: Your device
device.text: Phone, computer or TV opens the app and sends the request.

provider.title: Your provider
provider.text: To the provider this is an ordinary encrypted connection, with no list of sites.

server.title: Our server
server.text: The server accepts the subscription and reaches the network from its own address.

site.title: The site
site.text: The site opens as if you were browsing from another country.

path.callout: The connection stays ordinary even where a recognizable trace gets cut.

apps.title: One key for phone and computer
apps.text: The subscription opens in an app. The cabinet gives you the link and the steps after payment.

steps.title: Three steps to a working VPN
steps.subtitle: No manual configs, no fiddling with settings — everything happens in the bot or the dashboard.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.text: Open the Telegram bot or sign in to the dashboard — registration takes less than a minute.

plan.title: Pick a plan
plan.text: Pay however you like: card, SBP, crypto or Telegram Stars — the exact set depends on the service configuration.

connect.title: Connect
connect.text: Download the app from the link in your dashboard and import the subscription in one tap — the rest is automatic.

tariffs.title: You pay for the plan
tariffs.subtitle: The longer the term, the cheaper each month. Plan details and devices are in the dashboard.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Missing something? Message support — we will answer.

whatIs.q: What is a VPN and why do I need one?
whatIs.a: A VPN encrypts your traffic and routes it through its own server. Your provider and Wi-Fi owners stop seeing which sites you open, and the sites see the server address instead of yours.

devices.q: How many devices can I use?
devices.a: The device count depends on the plan and is listed on its page in the dashboard. You can raise the limit there as well.

apps.a: Any VLESS-capable client: INCY, Happ and others. The dashboard has a connect button that configures the app for you.

payment.q: How do I pay for a subscription?
payment.a: Through the Telegram bot or the dashboard. Available payment methods appear automatically and depend on the service configuration.

limits.q: Are there traffic or speed limits?
limits.a: We never throttle speed. The traffic limit depends on the plan — the exact figure is shown on the pricing page and in the dashboard.

refund.q: What if it does not work for me?
refund.a: Message support: we will sort out the setup or discuss a refund. Refund terms are described in the public offer.

cta.title: Ready to try it?
cta.subtitle: Set up {{brand}} in a couple of minutes and forget about blocks and lag.
